name: Naval
author: Sixth Front
description: A battle type: pick NAVAL on the main menu. A sea battle in Sapphire Strait, open water between rocky islands. Everyone commands a ship, one per soldier (up to 8 a side): destroyers with two 127 mm guns, torpedoes and anti-ship missiles, frigates with a fast 76 mm gun and missiles, and quick patrol boats with an autocannon and torpedoes. Pick the class on the deploy screen. The guns elevate by themselves to land where you aim; missiles need a lock; torpedoes run straight and hit hard. The flags are buoys out on the water.

battle.name: NAVAL
battle.tagline: Sapphire Strait. Destroyers, frigates and patrol boats fight for five buoys among the islands: gunnery at long range, torpedo runs up close, missiles that need a lock.

destroyer.name: DESTROYER
destroyer.blurb: Big, tough and slow. Two 127 mm guns fore and aft, four torpedoes, two anti-ship missiles, close-in guns against missiles.

frigate.name: FRIGATE
frigate.blurb: A rapid-fire 76 mm gun, anti-ship missiles and two torpedoes. Quicker to turn than a destroyer.

patrol.name: PATROL BOAT
patrol.blurb: Fast and fragile. A 30 mm autocannon and two forward torpedoes: get in close, launch, get out.
